reason: A is the better proposal because it specifies a concrete alloy, substitution, temperature and irradiation regime, matched baseline, and falsifiable thermal/mechanical tests. Its claimed conductivity gain and reduced scattering from Ni are weakly supported and may be physically incorrect, but B is more seriously undermined by an unspecified HEA and the likely instability, reaction, and interfacial thermal resistance of 3–5 wt% graphene at 700–1000 °C.
